shortDescription: Return available operating system options for SBM servers.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Endpoint to use to connect to API. Do not change until specifically asked to do otherwise. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: flavor_id
options.description: A unique identifier of an SBM flavor. Mutually exclusive with I(flavor_name).

options.name: flavor_name
options.description: Human-readable name of an SBM flavor (mutually exclusive with I(flavor_id)). If set the module will resolve the name to an ID and return OS options for that model.

options.name: location_code
options.description: Code of the location (e.g. V(AMS7)). Mutually exclusive with I(location_id).

options.name: location_id
options.description: Location identifier. Mutually exclusive with I(location_code).

options.name: os_name_regex
options.description: A regular expression to filter OS options by name. If specified, the module will return only OS options that match the provided regex.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use. You can create token for your account in https://portal.servers.com in Profile -> Public API section. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) or C(SC_TOKEN) environment variable is used (C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) takes precedence). Value is not logged.
